name: Partial duplication of the short arm of chromosome 2 syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Chromosomal microarray and cytogenetic analysis criteria

criteria.description: Identification of partial duplication involving the short arm of chromosome 2 by karyotyping or chromosomal microarray
Presence of global developmental delay or intellectual disability
Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphic features including hypertelorism, broad nasal bridge, and micrognathia
Presence of congenital anomalies such as cardiac defects or skeletal abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Cytogenetic confirmation of 2p partial duplication plus developmental delay or intellectual disability
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies primarily on genetic testing; clinical features support but are variable.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Partial duplication of chromosome 2p detected by cytogenetic analysis

searchTerms: global delay in growth and skills

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism including hypertelorism and broad nasal bridge
searchTerms: distinct facial features with wide eyes and broad nose
unusual face shape including broad nasal bridge

common.symptomName: Congenital heart defects (e.g., ventricular septal defect)

occasional.symptomName: Skeletal anomalies such as clinodactyly or scoliosis

laboratory: Possible metabolic screening abnormalities in some cases
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific white matter changes
genetic: Partial duplication of chromosome 2p detected by karyotype or chromosomal microarray
Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) confirming duplication region
other: Developmental and neuropsychological assessments confirming intellectual disability
Dysmorphology evaluation identifying characteristic facial features

distinguishingFeatures: Duplication involves long arm (2q) rather than short arm (2p)
Different pattern of dysmorphic features and congenital anomalies
Distinctive facial features and genetic cause (trisomy 21)
Characteristic cardiac defects and intellectual disability profile

redFlags: Severe developmental delay with unknown cause
Presence of multiple congenital anomalies including heart defects
Distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism suggestive of chromosomal abnormality
references: OMIM Entry 614290: Partial duplication of chromosome 2p
